title: [review] provisioning.py:408: Potential AttributeError calli
description: Line 408 calls `ack.encode()` on the return value of `node_session.create_ack()`. If `create_ack` returns raw bytes (which is typical for encrypted CBOR payloads), this will raise AttributeError since bytes objects have no `encode()` method. If `create_ack` returns a string, encoding it as UTF-8 for a CBOR content-format response would be incorrect. Verify the return type of `create_ack` and use `ack` directly if it returns bytes, or `ack.to_bytes()` if it's a dataclass.
